nodes.text:
Careful - everything in here is either cold or lying about it.

I keep the quench. Sib brews with it, Dain forges with it, and I am the one who makes sure it stays cold, which is a job that did not need to exist before.

choices.label: How do you keep it cold?
Eight of you left, I hear.

nodes.text:
I don't. It keeps itself, and I watch it very carefully in case it stops.

That is the honest answer and I have given up dressing it up. Nobody knows why this forge went out. I am a man employed to notice if it changes its mind.

Eight. Ost counts herself twice on bad days, for morale.

We have a rule that nobody says the number out loud after dark. You have just said it, but it is not dark, so I will allow it.
